class.name: TamaServerStraightLaserConfig
class.brief_description: A Resource that configures the appearance and lifetime of a straight (beam) laser type.
class.description:
[b]TamaServerStraightLaserConfig[/b] defines the visual properties and phase timings for a straight laser type registered in [TamaBulletRegistry] under the [member TamaBulletRegistry.objects] dictionary.
Straight lasers are rendered as an axis-aligned textured rectangle that extends [member length] pixels from the spawn position in the laser's direction. They pass through four phases:
[b]Phase 0 — delay:[/b] The laser appears as a one-pixel-wide line for [member delay_frames] physics frames. No collision. [b]Phase 1 — expand:[/b] The width grows from 1 pixel to [member width] over [member expand_frames] frames. Collision active. [b]Phase 2 — active:[/b] Full-width beam held for [member duration_frames] frames. Collision active. [b]Phase 3 — fade:[/b] Opacity decreases to zero over [member fade_frames] frames. No collision.
Straight lasers can run TamaScript [code]act[/code] blocks and respond to [code]chdir[/code], [code]chpos[/code], and [code]vanish[/code]. They can also [code]fire[/code] bullets from their [code]act[/code] block; the spawn position defaults to the laser's base position.
[b]Signals:[/b] hits are reported via [signal TamaManager.straight_laser_hit].

members.member: Full width of the laser beam in pixels at maximum expansion (phases 2 and 3).
Length of the beam rectangle in pixels, extending from the spawn position along the laser's angle.

Animated texture tiled or stretched across the laser body. Tiling behaviour is controlled by [member tile_x] and [member tile_y]. The [member TamaAnimatedTexture.blend_mode] of this texture is applied to all lasers of this type.
When [code]true[/code], the texture is tiled along the laser's length axis rather than stretched.
When [code]true[/code], the texture is tiled across the laser's width axis rather than stretched.
Optional animated texture drawn centred at the laser's spawn position (the base of the beam). Useful for an emitter flash or origin glow effect.
Physics frames to show the one-pixel "warning line" before the beam expands. No collision during this phase.
Physics frames over which the beam expands from 1 pixel to full [member width]. Collision is active during this phase.
Physics frames the beam holds at full width before fading. Collision is active during this phase.
Physics frames over which the beam fades to invisible before being recycled. No collision during this phase.
Maximum number of simultaneously active lasers of this type. Spawns beyond this limit are silently dropped.
Not used for straight lasers (they have a fixed lifetime and do not move outside the screen). Inherited from [TamaServerObjectConfig].
